notes: DynaColor Inc. (dynacolor.com.tw, Taiwanese OEM/ODM; also makes FA/machine-vision cameras, PTZ and NVRs) does not publish an RTSP URL path in its public documentation. Reviewed official DynaColor manuals hosted on ManualsLib — XB Series (manual/1227494), W Series (manual/955841), D7723 Series (manual/892577) and the 1080p15/720p30 Full-HD fixed dome quick guide (manual/2444603) — cover installation, DeviceSearch.exe discovery, browser/ActiveX access (default IP 192.168.0.250, Admin/1234) and web-UI Streaming > Video Format, but none state an rtsp:// URL format or a stream path name. Cameras are ONVIF-conformant, so ONVIF discovery is the practical route to the stream URI. The scan-DB candidates h264 / h264_2 match the classic DynaColor OEM scheme but could not be confirmed against any first-party DynaColor source, so status is left unverified rather than citing a non-manufacturer aggregator.
